Upper Text: If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.
＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Link +1＞ (Add 1 to this Digimon's maximum links.)

[When Digivolving] [End of Opponent’s Turn] You may link 1 Digimon card from your hand to this Digimon without paying the cost. Then, you may link 1 Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost.
